hypothesis: After variable-size separator spans are permitted, the remaining 0607ce86 blocker is the frozen peer reducer's assumption that every region shares identical relative-coordinate extents. Restricting peer reduction to the generic shared overlap domain while preserving non-overlap cells will yield valid transitions and may recover an exact training-consistent program.
baseline: ARC-R034 variable-span partition ablation with frozen equal-relative-coordinate peer semantics
primary_change: For each peer set, reduce only coordinates in the shared intersection of peer-region extents (minimum peer height and width), preserving cells outside that overlap unchanged. Do not change separator inference, reducer definitions, axes, write modes, search depth, or task set.
split: permitted public ARC-AGI-2 training data only
frozen_controls: variable-size separator-defined partition inference from ARC-R034
anti_overfit_constraints: no task IDs in DSL semantics
primary_metric: existence of an exact training-consistent program
success_threshold: At least one valid first-step transition and an exact training-consistent program within depth 4.
partial_success: At least one valid first-step transition but no exact program; classify shape-alignment blocker as removed while peer-reduction semantics remain insufficient.
falsification: No valid first-step transition after overlap-domain alignment, falsifying shared-overlap alignment as the proximate remaining blocker.
